Registered predictions at rho = 0.10 (validation):

| prediction | registered test (val) | result |
|---|---|---|
| RF1 recall ratchet | C1 accepted >= 5/6 in >= 2/3 seeds AND drift > 0.05 in >= 2/3 | accepted 3/3, drift 0/3 -> NOT supported |
| RF2 silent confidence loss | Spearman(mean p, flips) < 0 and mean p A6 < A0 in 3/3 | 3/3 -> supported |
| RF3 repair is gated | repair arm = poisoned arm until its first C1 rejection | supported (no C1 rejection in 3/3 runs) |
